result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The partially visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected scroll affordances and not defects. One genuine content/styling anomaly remains: the second 'Popular right now' card shows a discount badge reading '-0%', which is a meaningless discount value and looks like broken promotional data.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays '-0%', a nonsensical discount (zero percent off) that looks like broken promo data or a formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Suppress the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or fix the data/formatting so a real percentage (e.g. '-20%') is shown; ensure the badge only renders for valid non-zero discounts.

issues.description: The '-0%' badge uses a minus sign before the percentage while the promo banner elsewhere uses plain wording; inconsistent discount notation across the page adds to the broken appearance.
issues.suggestion: Standardize discount notation (e.g. '0% off' hidden, or '-X%') across badges and promo copy.
